evidence.approach: Attempt 9 fixes F1 and F2 from the attempt 8 review (return 128, scope note 130), Ruud's decision. Attempts 6 to 8's slices stand as delivered; this attempt adds one slice. F1: gates._require_the_kill_is_in_the_slice compares the killed mutants against the slice's names as written, while _require_mutation maps a test to its source through mutation.source_files first. The fix gives the kill check the same reading: the names it compares against are the slice's own names together with mutation.source_files of them, with existence answered against the repository root exactly as plan_source_files and _require_mutation do. The caller (the red branch of the citation check, gates.py:1023) already holds `repository` and passes it through. Keeping the raw names in the union means every slice the check accepted before is still accepted; the mapping only adds the source a named test stands for, so a slice naming packages/core/src/fee.test.ts accepts a kill in packages/core/src/fee.ts, which is the slice the floor refusal tells the author to write. F2: mutation_ci.CONFIG_FILES gains packages/core/tsconfig.json, which the TypeScript checker reads, so a change to it widens CI to all of src like the other three configuration files, rather than reusing incremental results taken under the old compiler settings.

slices.name: The kill check maps a test to its source, and tsconfig.json widens CI
slices.red: A killed-mutant RED in packages/core/src/fee.ts is refused for a slice that names only packages/core/src/fee.test.ts, and select over a changed packages/core/tsconfig.json returns None instead of all of src.

alternatives: Replace the slice's names with mutation.source_files of them instead of taking the union: rejected, source_files drops everything outside packages/core/src and every non-.ts file, so a slice that names a directory or a file outside src would change behaviour for no reason this finding gives; the union only widens.

Have the floor refusal tell the author to name the source file as well as the test: rejected, it moves the mismatch to the author's plan rather than removing it, and the two gate functions would still read a slice differently.
Widen CI on any change to a file under packages/core that is not under src: rejected, it would mutate everything for a README edit; the configuration files the run reads are a short, known list.
Defer F1 and F2 to a follow-up ticket: rejected by Ruud's decision at record 130.
risks: The kill check now accepts a kill in the source a named test stands for, which is wider than before: it is exactly the file _require_mutation already measures for that slice, so the RED and the floor now agree on one file; a test with no sibling source maps to nothing new and is judged as before.

Existence is read from the working tree, so a source file deleted in the slice would not be mapped: source_files counts a sibling the same list names as there, and a slice that deletes source has no mutant in it to kill.
evidence.rollback: Revert the attempt 9 commit; the kill check returns to the raw names, which only re-adds the refusal F1 describes, and CI stops widening on tsconfig.json, with no data to migrate.
